scripts.build:all: npm run migrate:drafts && npm run build && npm run pages && npm run sitemap
scripts.dev: npm run build:all && npx serve public -p 4003
scripts.deploy:vercel:cutoff: npm run clean && CUTOFF_ID=$CUTOFF_ID npm run build:all && DEPLOY_PROVIDER=vercel ./system/workflow/deploy.sh
scripts.deploy:vercel:ids: npm run clean && PUBLISH_IDS=$PUBLISH_IDS npm run build:all && DEPLOY_PROVIDER=vercel ./system/workflow/deploy.sh
scripts.deploy:vercel:select: npm run clean && CUTOFF_ID=$CUTOFF_ID PUBLISH_IDS=$PUBLISH_IDS npm run build:all && DEPLOY_PROVIDER=vercel ./system/workflow/deploy.sh
